title: Implementing scalable metered billing with Stripe: How Edgee handles billions of events
summary: Discover how Edgee built a scalable, usage-based billing system processing billions of requests across 100+ global edge locations. Learn how they leverage Stripe’s metering and billing APIs to ensure accurate, resilient invoicing in a complex distributed architecture, all while solving critical web analytics data loss challenges.
